about:
Texas Microelectronics Corporation (TxMC) operates from Houston, Texas, where it was established over three decades ago. The company remains privately held, though ownership details such as family or veteran status are not publicly disclosed.

TxMC specializes in designing and manufacturing high-temperature, high-reliability custom hybrid circuits and multi-chip modules. Its services span design consultation, manufacturing, design integration, and packaging solutions. The firm also offers a catalog of standard products including ASIC multi-chip modules, switching DC-DC converters, linear regulators, high-voltage power supplies, analog-to-digital converters, amplifiers, and memory devices, all rated for case temperatures up to 230 °C. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

The company serves the oil and gas, aerospace, aerial drone, geothermal energy, and communications sectors. Customers range from research-and-development programs to accelerated high-performance product development teams.

TxMC emphasizes a partnership model with clients, citing its ISO 9000:2015, AS9100, and ITAR certifications as foundations for quality and compliance. The ability to deliver reliable operation at extreme temperatures is presented as a core differentiator.
